(2) LIMITER: foreign-prior FBP-ceiling on dense Mayo. (3) ONE KNOB: NONE genuinely-untried in-budget exists -- audited: ram_disable_multiscale True->False would re-enable per-scale physics evals across 214 slices (iter-1 noted multiscale-disabled CUTS per-slice physics evals), pushing the already-985s inference path over the 1200s wall WITHOUT being an inference-quality lever (changes runtime, not whether the foreign prior carries LDCT signal); ram_clamp_output True->False is degenerate on an RMSE-sensitive metric (unclamping can only let pixels drift out of range = neutral-or-worse, non-diagnostic); there is no seed lever (zero-shot single-forward-pass denoiser is deterministic, frozen weights/no sampling -> iter-5 & iter-7 reproduced SSIM 0.9070974588394165 BIT-IDENTICALLY); ram_finetune is budget-infeasible. => iter-8 runs the CLEAN CONFIRMATION: re-run the best inference point (empty patch on BASE_ITER=5) to document RAM as FBP-bounded on dense 2304-view Mayo. (4) HYPOTHESIS: hr stays EXACTLY 0.0 at SSIM 0.9071 (bit-identical determinism). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if this re-run lands hr != 0.0 OR SSIM != 0.9070974588394165, the iter-5/iter-7 reads were NOT stable (non-determinism in the zero-shot path) and the ceiling read must be re-audited; otherwise the FBP-bound ceiling is confirmed for the 3rd time and the finetune lever is retired as budget-infeasible (NOT a negative architectural result). (5) SIZE/BUDGET <=1200s: INFERENCE-ONLY (ram_finetune=False), IDENTICAL compute profile to iter-5/iter-7 (985.9s/989.8s = 16.4 min, ~4.6s/slice x 214 single forward passes + one op-norm power iter), comfortably under the HARD 1200s=20-min budget; ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False avoids extra deepinv-tomo physics evals; ZERO finetune cost (finetune OFF, NOT enabled). sbatch --time=00:30:00 backstop wall (no in-solver wall knob in solver_ram.py). val=ALL 214 L277 slices. (6) no control return. HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geom, per-sample-ps (single-val-ps probe, val-only solver), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277, 321px FOV DEFAULT (no fov=False). NEVER edit ddssl_ldct/ or the solver file.
